GuidanceFrontier.lean.text:
/-
Selected design: keep STAR; retain operational guidance separately from data
coverage. C2 below is the existing imported scalar policy, without overrides.

Scope: finite FULL scalar lists, ordinary nonstatic bases, counted fields,
Empty E, no ZERO data transfer, GROUP/mx, aliases, ND transfer or field budget.
ZERO/ND appear only in the existing source-handoff selector truth table.
Exit labels are opaque complete coordinates: no exit component is recomputed.

This proves local union and image facts once exact paired rows are available.
It does NOT prove rows arrive from point/summary producers or survive their
normalization. Producer-transition, ownership, 39-adapter and global effect
obligations remain OPEN. No assumed arrival invariant closes those gaps.
-/
import RestrictedInitialPolicy

namespace GuidanceFrontier
open ApSpec

abbrev Demand := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Demand
abbrev Input := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Input
abbrev Mark := RestrictedInitialPolicy.Mark

structure Row where
  query : Demand
  exitLabel : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Exact paired-row union. Lists implement finite set membership; duplicates
and order have no meaning in the image predicates below. This is the guide
algebra, not a data-coverage antichain and not a callback-count theorem. -/
def guideUnion (left right : List Row) : List Row := left ++ right

def containsBy (accept : Row → Bool) : List Row → Bool
  | [] => false
  | row :: rest => accept row || containsBy accept rest

/-- Apply unchanged C2 to each retained query coordinate. -/
def c2Image (rows : List Row) (actual initial : Input) : Bool :=
  containsBy (fun row => decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit row.query actual = some initial)) rows

/-- Paired admission image: C2 emits an initial and keeps that same row's
complete opaque exit label. Production C5 restriction, canStoreInitial and
budget are not modeled. containsBy can later accept an actual C5-row predicate. -/
def pairedAdmissionImage (rows : List Row) (actual initial : Input) (exitLabel : Nat) : Bool :=
  containsBy (fun row =>
    decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit row.query actual = some initial) &&
      Nat.beq row.exitLabel exitLabel) rows

theorem contains_guide_union (accept : Row → Bool) (left right : List Row) :
    containsBy accept (guideUnion left right) =
      (containsBy accept left || containsBy accept right) := by
  induction left with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons row rest ih =>
    simpa only [guideUnion, List.cons_append, containsBy, Bool.or_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun value => accept row || value) ih

theorem guide_union_both_orders (accept : Row → Bool) (left right : List Row) :
    containsBy accept (guideUnion left right) =
      containsBy accept (guideUnion right left) := by
  rw [contains_guide_union, contains_guide_union]
  exact Bool.or_comm _ _

theorem c2_image_union (left right : List Row) (actual initial : Input) :
    c2Image (guideUnion left right) actual initial =
      (c2Image left actual initial || c2Image right actual initial) :=
  contains_guide_union _ left right

theorem paired_admission_image_union (left right : List Row) (actual initial : Input)
    (label : Nat) :
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion left right) actual initial label =
      (pairedAdmissionImage left actual initial label || pairedAdmissionImage right actual initial label) :=
  contains_guide_union _ left right

theorem paired_admission_image_both_orders (left right : List Row) (actual initial : Input)
    (label : Nat) :
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion left right) actual initial label =
      pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion right left) actual initial label :=
  guide_union_both_orders _ left right

/-- Separate DATA algebra. This local ANY-prefix coverage recognizer is used
only to exhibit loss; it does not claim to model all native canonicalization. -/
def queryCovers (broad narrow : Demand) : Bool :=
  decide (broad.base = narrow.base) && decide (broad.mark = narrow.mark) &&
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq broad.shape .any &&
    (dropPrefix broad.path narrow.path).isSome

def dataCovers (broad narrow : Row) : Bool :=
  Nat.beq broad.exitLabel narrow.exitLabel && queryCovers broad.query narrow.query

def dataInsert (row : Row) (rows : List Row) : List Row :=
  if rows.any (fun old => dataCovers old row) then rows
  else row :: rows.filter (fun old => !(dataCovers row old))

def p : Nat := 1
def f : Acc := 7
def T : Mark := .full 11
def d0 : Demand := ⟨p, [], .any, .flow⟩
def d1 : Demand := ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow⟩
def rootRow : Row := ⟨d0, 17⟩
def childRow : Row := ⟨d1, 17⟩
def actualChildMust : Input := ⟨p, [f], .any, T, true⟩
def childStarFlow : Input := ⟨p, [f], .star, .flow, false⟩
def childMustFlow : Input := ⟨p, [f], .any, .flow, true⟩

def anyQuerySupports (query : Demand) (location : List Acc) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.shapeEq query.shape .any &&
    (dropPrefix query.path location).isSome

theorem denotational_root_ANY_covers_child_ANY (location : List Acc) :
    anyQuerySupports d1 location = true → anyQuerySupports d0 location = true := by
  intro _
  rfl

theorem unchanged_C2_has_distinct_root_child_images :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d0 actualChildMust = some childStarFlow ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d1 actualChildMust = some childMustFlow ∧
    childStarFlow ≠ childMustFlow := by decide

theorem guide_pair_keeps_both_images_in_both_orders :
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]) actualChildMust childStarFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]) actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [childRow] [rootRow]) actualChildMust childStarFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion [childRow] [rootRow]) actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true := by decide

theorem DATA_prefix_removal_discards_child_in_both_orders :
    dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow []) = [rootRow] ∧
    dataInsert rootRow (dataInsert childRow []) = [rootRow] := by decide

theorem DATA_coverage_is_not_C2_image_equivalence :
    queryCovers d0 d1 = true ∧
    c2Image [rootRow] actualChildMust childMustFlow = false ∧
    c2Image (guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]) actualChildMust childMustFlow = true := by decide

/-- A later exact-union store can retain what it receives, but cannot recover
this missing coordinate from a producer that already emitted only rootRow.
This is a countermodel, not a claim about which native producer owns the loss. -/
theorem late_store_retention_cannot_recover_discarded_child :
    guideUnion (dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow [])) [] = [rootRow] ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (guideUnion (dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow [])) [])
      actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = false := by decide

theorem exact_pairing_does_not_cross_exit_labels :
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childStarFlow 41 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childMustFlow 42 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childStarFlow 42 = false ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨d0, 41⟩, ⟨d1, 42⟩] actualChildMust childMustFlow 41 = false := by decide

inductive Layer where | normal | demand
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Direction where | forward | backward
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Origin where | initial (isZero : Bool) | nd
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Existing source-handoff selection, not a new all-NORMAL export rule. -/
def selectedForHandoff : Layer → Direction → Origin → Bool
  | .demand, _, _ => true
  | .normal, _, .nd => true
  | .normal, .backward, .initial true => true
  | _, _, _ => false

theorem source_handoff_selector_table :
    selectedForHandoff .demand .forward (.initial false) = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .demand .backward (.initial false) = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .forward .nd = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .backward .nd = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .backward (.initial true) = true ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .forward (.initial true) = false ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .forward (.initial false) = false ∧
    selectedForHandoff .normal .backward (.initial false) = false := by decide

/-- Empty-E scalar part of guidancePattern: MUST loses its must flag, keeps
its ANY geometry, and other heads stay themselves. No emitter is changed. -/
def guidanceHead (actual : Input) : Demand :=
  ⟨actual.base, actual.path, actual.shape, actual.mark⟩

theorem guidance_MUST_ANY_and_other_heads :
    guidanceHead actualChildMust = ⟨p, [f], .any, T⟩ ∧
    guidanceHead ⟨p, [f], .star, T, false⟩ = ⟨p, [f], .star, T⟩ ∧
    guidanceHead ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ = ⟨p, [f], .exact, T⟩ := by decide

/-- Same point, concrete MAY versus EXACT guidance. ANY geometry may cover
EXACT geometry while selecting a different current C2 initial. This shows why
guide retention must inspect all heads, not just proper-prefix ANY pairs. -/
def mayQuery : Demand := ⟨p, [], .any, T⟩
def exactQuery : Demand := ⟨p, [], .exact, T⟩
def actualRootMay : Input := ⟨p, [], .any, T, false⟩
def rootExact : Input := ⟨p, [], .exact, T, false⟩

theorem same_point_MAY_EXACT_guide_countercell :
    queryCovers mayQuery exactQuery = true ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit mayQuery actualRootMay = some actualRootMay ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit exactQuery actualRootMay = some rootExact ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨mayQuery, 17⟩] actualRootMay rootExact 17 = false ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage [⟨mayQuery, 17⟩, ⟨exactQuery, 17⟩] actualRootMay rootExact 17 = true := by decide

/-- A concrete row-union witness that root can evaluate without choice. -/
def retainedRows : List Row := guideUnion [rootRow] [childRow]

theorem retained_rows_are_an_executable_witness :
    retainedRows = [rootRow, childRow] ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage retainedRows actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true := by decide

#eval retainedRows
#eval (pairedAdmissionImage retainedRows actualChildMust childMustFlow 17)
#print axioms contains_guide_union
#print axioms guide_union_both_orders
#print axioms c2_image_union
#print axioms paired_admission_image_union
#print axioms paired_admission_image_both_orders
#print axioms denotational_root_ANY_covers_child_ANY
#print axioms unchanged_C2_has_distinct_root_child_images
#print axioms guide_pair_keeps_both_images_in_both_orders
#print axioms DATA_prefix_removal_discards_child_in_both_orders
#print axioms DATA_coverage_is_not_C2_image_equivalence
#print axioms late_store_retention_cannot_recover_discarded_child
#print axioms exact_pairing_does_not_cross_exit_labels
#print axioms source_handoff_selector_table
#print axioms guidance_MUST_ANY_and_other_heads
#print axioms same_point_MAY_EXACT_guide_countercell
#print axioms retained_rows_are_an_executable_witness

end GuidanceFrontier

ProducerGuidance.lean.text:
/-
Local producer algebra for the selected demand-guidance design.
No current C2 policy is changed. No native producer equivalence is asserted.

Finite scope: FLOW/DEMAND/ANY operational coordinates, ordinary bases, Empty E,
counted paths, FULL marks from a two-atom table. Headers still carry kind, base,
layer, tail, E and mx. Admitted input coordinates supply an opaque complete exit
label. No premise or admission fact is synthesized by handoff.

Raw states are executable characteristic views of finite coordinate packets.
Function equality below means coordinate membership equality, not packet order,
duplicate multiplicity, native DAG layout, queue effects or callback counts.
Runtime mark requests and every producer/adapter transition remain OPEN.
-/
import GuidanceFrontier

namespace ProducerGuidance
open ApSpec GuidanceFrontier

inductive Kind where | flow | taint | reach
deriving DecidableEq, Repr
inductive Tail where | exact | star | any | must
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Finite FULL-only exclusion table. No group/catalog normalization is modeled. -/
structure Mx where
  tExcluded : Bool
  uExcluded : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Header where
  kind : Kind
  base : Nat
  layer : GuidanceFrontier.Layer
  tail : Tail
  exclusion : Excl
  mx : Mx
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Coordinate where
  header : Header
  path : List Acc
  exitLabel : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

abbrev RawState := Coordinate → Bool

def emptyState : RawState := fun _ => false
def rawView : List Coordinate → RawState
  | [] => emptyState
  | head :: rest => fun coordinate => decide (coordinate = head) || rawView rest coordinate

def rawAdd (old incoming : RawState) : RawState :=
  fun coordinate => old coordinate || incoming coordinate

def rawDelta (old incoming : RawState) : RawState :=
  fun coordinate => incoming coordinate && !(old coordinate)

theorem raw_view_append (left right : List Coordinate) :
    rawView (left ++ right) = rawAdd (rawView left) (rawView right) := by
  funext coordinate
  induction left with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head rest ih =>
    simpa only [List.cons_append, rawView, rawAdd, Bool.or_assoc] using
      congrArg (fun value => decide (coordinate = head) || value) ih

theorem raw_add_preserves_old (old incoming : RawState) (coordinate : Coordinate)
    (present : old coordinate = true) : rawAdd old incoming coordinate = true := by
  simp [rawAdd, present]

theorem raw_add_preserves_incoming (old incoming : RawState) (coordinate : Coordinate)
    (present : incoming coordinate = true) : rawAdd old incoming coordinate = true := by
  simp [rawAdd, present]

theorem raw_delta_is_exact_coordinate_freshness (old incoming : RawState)
    (coordinate : Coordinate) :
    rawDelta old incoming coordinate = true ↔
      incoming coordinate = true ∧ old coordinate = false := by
  cases hOld : old coordinate <;> cases hNew : incoming coordinate <;>
    simp [rawDelta, hOld, hNew]

theorem exact_duplicate_has_no_delta (state : RawState) :
    rawDelta state state = emptyState := by
  funext coordinate
  cases h : state coordinate <;> simp [rawDelta, emptyState, h]

theorem raw_add_is_idempotent (state : RawState) : rawAdd state state = state := by
  funext coordinate
  cases h : state coordinate <;> simp [rawAdd, h]

theorem raw_add_is_order_independent (left right : RawState) :
    rawAdd left right = rawAdd right left := by
  funext coordinate
  exact Bool.or_comm _ _

theorem delta_reconstructs_added_memberships (old incoming : RawState) :
    rawAdd old (rawDelta old incoming) = rawAdd old incoming := by
  funext coordinate
  cases hOld : old coordinate <;> cases hNew : incoming coordinate <;>
    simp [rawAdd, rawDelta, hOld, hNew]

def mxEmpty : Mx := ⟨false, false⟩
def mxT : Mx := ⟨true, false⟩
def selectedHeader : Header := ⟨.flow, p, .demand, .any, Excl.empty, mxEmpty⟩
def rootCoordinate : Coordinate := ⟨selectedHeader, [], 17⟩
def childCoordinate : Coordinate := ⟨selectedHeader, [f], 17⟩
def rootState : RawState := rawView [rootCoordinate]
def childState : RawState := rawView [childCoordinate]

theorem root_first_child_is_fresh :
    rawDelta rootState childState childCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd rootState childState rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd rootState childState childCoordinate = true := by decide

theorem child_first_root_is_fresh :
    rawDelta childState rootState rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd childState rootState rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawAdd childState rootState childCoordinate = true := by decide

theorem cold_packet_preserves_both_coordinates :
    rawDelta emptyState (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]) rootCoordinate = true ∧
    rawDelta emptyState (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]) childCoordinate = true ∧
    rawDelta (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      (rawView [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate]) childCoordinate = false := by decide

def withMx (coordinate : Coordinate) (mx : Mx) : Coordinate :=
  { coordinate with header := { coordinate.header with mx := mx } }

theorem full_header_mx_path_and_exit_are_coordinates :
    rawView [rootCoordinate] (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with layer := .normal } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with tail := .star } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with exclusion := .set [f] } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with base := p + 1 } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with
      header := { selectedHeader with kind := .taint } } = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] childCoordinate = false ∧
    rawView [rootCoordinate] { rootCoordinate with exitLabel := 18 } = false := by decide

theorem DATA_coverage_and_GUIDE_freshness_are_different :
    queryCovers d0 d1 = true ∧
    dataInsert childRow (dataInsert rootRow []) = [rootRow] ∧
    rawDelta rootState childState childCoordinate = true := by decide

/-- Projection of already supplied eligible rows. FLOW mark exclusions are
dropped by guidancePattern. This local projection does not validate admission,
create exit coordinates, evaluate C5, or prove a native producer reaches here. -/
def handoff (coordinate : Coordinate) : Option Row :=
  let header := coordinate.header
  if header.kind = .flow ∧ header.layer = .demand ∧ header.tail = .any ∧
      header.exclusion = Excl.empty then
    some ⟨⟨header.base, coordinate.path, .any, .flow⟩, coordinate.exitLabel⟩
  else none

def handoffRows (packet : List Coordinate) : List Row := packet.filterMap handoff

def rawObservation (accept : Row → Bool) : List Coordinate → Bool
  | [] => false
  | coordinate :: rest =>
    (match handoff coordinate with | none => false | some row => accept row) ||
      rawObservation accept rest

theorem handoff_preserves_exact_rows_for_any_observation
    (accept : Row → Bool) (packet : List Coordinate) :
    containsBy accept (handoffRows packet) = rawObservation accept packet := by
  induction packet with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons coordinate rest ih =>
    cases h : handoff coordinate with
    | none => simpa [handoffRows, List.filterMap_cons, h, rawObservation, containsBy] using ih
    | some row =>
      simpa only [handoffRows, List.filterMap_cons, h, rawObservation, containsBy] using
        congrArg (fun value => accept row || value) ih

theorem handoff_paired_admission_image_equivalence
    (packet : List Coordinate) (actual initial : Input) (label : Nat) :
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows packet) actual initial label =
      rawObservation (fun row =>
        decide (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit row.query actual = some initial) &&
          Nat.beq row.exitLabel label) packet :=
  handoff_preserves_exact_rows_for_any_observation _ packet

theorem handoff_root_child_both_orders :
    handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate] = [rootRow, childRow] ∧
    handoffRows [childCoordinate, rootCoordinate] = [childRow, rootRow] := by decide

theorem current_STAR_policy_and_child_MUST_image_are_unchanged :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d0 actualChildMust = some childStarFlow ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d1 actualChildMust = some childMustFlow ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      actualChildMust childStarFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [childCoordinate, rootCoordinate])
      actualChildMust childMustFlow 17 = true := by decide

/-- Retaining the same-head guide also exposes the existing abstract EXACT
cell. This is another scalar image, not a new emitter or layer policy. -/
theorem retained_child_keeps_existing_exact_FLOW_image :
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d0 ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ = some childStarFlow ∧
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d1 ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ =
      some ⟨p, [f], .exact, .flow, false⟩ ∧
    pairedAdmissionImage (handoffRows [rootCoordinate, childCoordinate])
      ⟨p, [f], .exact, T, false⟩ ⟨p, [f], .exact, .flow, false⟩ 17 = true := by decide

theorem handoff_projection_drops_mx (coordinate : Coordinate) (mx : Mx) :
    handoff (withMx coordinate mx) = handoff coordinate := rfl

/-- Intersection of excluded atoms is union of admitted FULL atoms. -/
def mxJoinAdmitted (left right : Mx) : Mx :=
  ⟨left.tExcluded && right.tExcluded, left.uExcluded && right.uExcluded⟩

theorem same_head_mx_union_only_after_projection
    (coordinate : Coordinate) (left right : Mx) (accept : Row → Bool) :
    rawObservation accept [withMx coordinate left, withMx coordinate right] =
      rawObservation accept [withMx coordinate (mxJoinAdmitted left right)] := by
  simp only [rawObservation, handoff_projection_drops_mx]
  cases handoff coordinate <;> simp

def requestT (coordinate : Coordinate) : Bool := !(coordinate.header.mx.tExcluded)

def requestU (coordinate : Coordinate) : Bool := !(coordinate.header.mx.uExcluded)

/-- Existing cofinite union preserves the union of requests at this exact head.
This does not authorize prefix pruning or infer equivalence from projection. -/
theorem same_head_mx_intersection_preserves_T_request_union
    (coordinate : Coordinate) (left right : Mx) :
    requestT (withMx coordinate (mxJoinAdmitted left right)) =
      (requestT (withMx coordinate left) || requestT (withMx coordinate right)) := by
  cases hl : left.tExcluded <;> cases hr : right.tExcluded <;>
    simp [requestT, withMx, mxJoinAdmitted, hl, hr]

theorem same_head_mx_intersection_preserves_U_request_union
    (coordinate : Coordinate) (left right : Mx) :
    requestU (withMx coordinate (mxJoinAdmitted left right)) =
      (requestU (withMx coordinate left) || requestU (withMx coordinate right)) := by
  cases hl : left.uExcluded <;> cases hr : right.uExcluded <;>
    simp [requestU, withMx, mxJoinAdmitted, hl, hr]

theorem same_mx_projection_does_not_prove_runtime_request_equivalence :
    handoff (withMx rootCoordinate mxEmpty) = handoff (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) ∧
    requestT (withMx rootCoordinate mxEmpty) = true ∧
    requestT (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) = false ∧
    rawDelta rootState (rawView [withMx rootCoordinate mxT])
      (withMx rootCoordinate mxT) = true := by decide

#print axioms handoff_paired_admission_image_equivalence
#print axioms handoff_root_child_both_orders

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the finite guidance model against the unchanged scalar C2 model."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile


HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LEAN_ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
BASE = LEAN_ROOT / 'proposals/initial-emission/RestrictedInitialPolicy.lean'
MODEL = HERE / 'GuidanceFrontier.lean'
PRODUCER = HERE / 'ProducerGuidance.lean'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    modules = []
    for path, count in ((MODEL, 16), (PRODUCER, 23)):
        model = path.read_text()
        assert not re.search(r'^\s*(?:axiom|opaque|noncomputable)\b', model, re.M)
        assert not re.search(r'\b(?:sorry|admit|Classical)\b', re.sub(r'/\-.*?\-/', '', model, flags=re.S))
        names = re.findall(r'^theorem (\w+)', model, re.M)
        printed = re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\w+)', model, re.M)
        assert len(names) == count and names == printed
        modules.append({'file': path.name, 'sha256': sha(path), 'theorems': count})
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='guidance-frontier-') as temporary:
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env['LEAN_PATH'] = temporary + os.pathsep + env.get('LEAN_PATH', '')
        commands = [
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '-M2048', '-o', str(Path(temporary) / 'RestrictedInitialPolicy.olean'), str(BASE)],
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '-M2048', '-o', str(Path(temporary) / 'GuidanceFrontier.olean'), str(MODEL)],
            ['lake', 'env', 'lean', '-M2048', str(PRODUCER)],
        ]
        outputs = []
        for command in commands:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=LEAN_ROOT, env=env,
                                    text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            if result.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError(result.stdout)
            assert 'error:' not in result.stdout and 'sorryAx' not in result.stdout
            outputs.append(result.stdout)
    all_output = '\n'.join(outputs)
    for dependencies in re.findall(r'depends on axioms:\s*\[([^]]*)\]', all_output, re.S):
        assert set(dependencies.replace('\n', '').replace(' ', '').split(',')) <= {'propext', 'Quot.sound'}
    audit = [line for output in outputs[1:] for line in output.splitlines()
             if line.startswith(("'GuidanceFrontier.", "'ProducerGuidance."))]
    total = sum(module['theorems'] for module in modules)
    assert len(audit) == total
    receipt = {
        'state': 'PASS', 'model': MODEL.name, 'modelSha256': sha(MODEL),
        'base': str(BASE.relative_to(LEAN_ROOT)), 'baseSha256': sha(BASE),
        'leanToolchain': (LEAN_ROOT / 'lean-toolchain').read_text().strip(),
        'theorems': total, 'modules': modules, 'axiomAudit': audit,
        'allowedFoundationAxioms': ['propext', 'Quot.sound'],
        'scope': 'finite C2 images, coordinate add/delta, exact paired-label handoff and same-head mx request union; unchanged scalar emit',
        'notProved': ['producer retention before normalization', 'production C5 restriction and budgets',
                      'role transitions and engine adapters', 'whole-engine effect or final Conductor recovery'],
    }
    encoded = json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n'
    if args.output:
        args.output.write_text(encoded)
    print(encoded, end='')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# Demand guidance retention: finite model

Selected behavior: keep STAR and repair demand guidance. The model imports the
existing scalar C2 model without changes. It does not use the rejected
first-field MUST emitter.

Run from the repository root:

```bash
python3 spec/lean/proposals/demand-guidance-retention-20261106/check.py
```

The checker compiles the existing scalar model into a temporary directory,
then checks this model. It checks every printed axiom dependency. It permits
only the existing constructive foundations `propext` and `Quot.sound`. It
does not write to `formal/` or change the scalar model.

The first 16 lemmas prove finite C2-image and paired-label properties. Exact row
union keeps root and child demand positions in either arrival order. Data
prefix removal can lose the child's C2 image. The model also checks the
existing handoff selector, MUST-to-ANY guidance projection, and a same-point
concrete MAY/EXACT counterexample. Exit labels are complete opaque identities.
The model cannot borrow an exit from a different row.

`ProducerGuidance.lean` adds 23 lemmas for exact coordinate add/delta,
freshness, duplicates, both arrival orders, and the handoff of already supplied
paired coordinates. It also checks the existing same-head mx intersection:
the allowed T/U request set is the union of its inputs in the finite FULL
table. A separate counterexample shows why equal projected demand rows alone
do not prove equal runtime requests. The same-head exact-input cell is checked
too: its existing EXACT/FLOW initial can appear beside the parent's STAR/FLOW
initial. The checker runs all 39 lemmas.

The scope is FULL scalar facts, ordinary nonstatic bases, counted fields,
empty field exclusions, and finite lists. No production C5 restriction,
field-budget cut, alias transfer, static flow, ND transfer, or ZERO transfer
is proved. ZERO and ND occur only in the handoff selector table.

These proofs start with available exact rows. They do not prove that all
producer paths retain those rows before publication. The late-store example
shows why that distinction matters. Role transitions, engine adapters, and
the required source/sink effects remain open. These local lemmas do not prove
final Conductor recovery or whole-engine correctness.

The [design draft](../../../../docs/design/bidirectional-demand-guidance-retention-implementation-20261106.md)
and [complete local Conductor snapshot](../../../../docs/reports/bidirectional-conductor-must-demand-snapshot-20261106.md)
state the implementation and evidence limits.

/-
  Restricted initial policy: FULL scalar, ordinary nonstatic bases, Empty E.
  Every modeled accessor is a counted field. Static anchors, ZERO, GROUP,
  mark exclusions and field exclusions require separate adapters/proofs.

  MUST is an explicit Boolean independent of an edge layer. Demand has no
  MUST tail. FLOW metadata is accepted only by a FLOW demand; it cannot
  supply a concrete full mark. Such metadata also permits structural image
  queries without inventing a concrete caller input.

  Historical policy below: precise STAR/EXACT demand emits only EXACT at its
  own path; a proper descendant does not apply. The selected DemandStarPolicy
  namespace at the end supersedes only the STAR proper-descendant cell.
  ANY demand resolves at most one new
  field, with the terminal concrete EXACT exception. Same-prefix supplied
  STAR emits nothing. Ancestor STAR for ANY demand also emits nothing:
  this last row is the stated inferred no-ANY/no-refinement interpretation.
  Ancestor ANY/MUST descends to the ANY demand path and retains its tail.

  No application/normal-record repair or abstract-tail transfer is selected
  in this file. It defines admission and proves its structural image.
-/
import ApSpec.CorrelatedConcreteImplementation

namespace RestrictedInitialPolicy
open ApSpec

inductive Shape where
  | exact | star | any
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Mark where
  | flow | full (id : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def shapeEq : Shape → Shape → Bool
  | .exact, .exact | .star, .star | .any, .any => true
  | _, _ => false

structure Demand where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  shape : Shape
  mark : Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  base : Nat
  path : List Acc
  shape : Shape
  mark : Mark
  must : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def fullMark : Mark → Bool
  | .full _ => true
  | .flow => false

def acceptsMark (required supplied : Mark) : Bool :=
  match required, supplied with
  | .flow, _ => true
  | .full t, .full u => Nat.beq t u
  | .full _, .flow => false

def validInput (a : Input) : Bool := !a.must || shapeEq a.shape .any

inductive Template where
  | rootExact
  | rootAny (must : Bool)
  | childStar (field : Acc)
  | childExact (field : Acc)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def render (d : Demand) : Template → Input
  | .rootExact => ⟨d.base, d.path, .exact, d.mark, false⟩
  | .rootAny must => ⟨d.base, d.path, .any, d.mark, must⟩
  | .childStar f => ⟨d.base, d.path ++ [f], .star, d.mark, false⟩
  | .childExact f => ⟨d.base, d.path ++ [f], .exact, d.mark, false⟩

def validTemplate (d : Demand) : Template → Bool
  | .rootExact => true
  | .rootAny _ | .childStar _ => shapeEq d.shape .any
  | .childExact _ => shapeEq d.shape .any && fullMark d.mark

def rawTemplate (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Template :=
  if validInput a && Nat.beq d.base a.base && acceptsMark d.mark a.mark then
    match d.shape, relate d.path a.path with
    | .any, .below [] =>
      match a.shape with
      | .exact => some .rootExact
      | .any => some (.rootAny a.must)
      | .star => none
    | .any, .below (f :: rest) =>
      if fullMark d.mark && shapeEq a.shape .exact && rest.isEmpty then
        some (.childExact f)
      else some (.childStar f)
    | .any, .above _ => if shapeEq a.shape .any then some (.rootAny a.must) else none
    | .any, .apart => none
    | _, .below [] => some .rootExact
    | _, .below (_ :: _) => none
    | _, .above _ => if shapeEq a.shape .exact then none else some .rootExact
    | _, .apart => none
  else none

/-- The explicit template validity check is a finite domain check, not an
    additional matching policy. rawTemplate's selected cells render these
    canonical templates only. -/
def selectTemplate (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Template :=
  match rawTemplate d a with
  | none => none
  | some t => if validTemplate d t then some t else none

def emit (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Input :=
  match selectTemplate d a with
  | none => none
  | some t => some (render d t)

theorem mark_accepts_itself (m : Mark) : acceptsMark m m = true := by
  cases m with
  | flow => rfl
  | full t => exact Nat.beq_refl t

theorem template_is_its_own_emission (d : Demand) (t : Template)
    (valid : validTemplate d t = true) :
    emit d (render d t) = some (render d t) := by
  have self : dropPrefix d.path d.path = some [] :=
    ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' d.path
  cases d with
  | mk base path shape mark =>
    cases t with
    | rootExact =>
      cases shape <;> cases mark <;>
        simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
          relate, self, validTemplate, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true,
          shapeEq, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or]
    | rootAny must =>
      cases shape <;> simp [validTemplate, shapeEq] at valid
      cases mark <;>
        simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
          relate, self, validTemplate, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true, Bool.or_true, shapeEq]
    | childStar f =>
      have hpath : dropPrefix path (path ++ [f]) = some [f] :=
        CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
      cases shape <;> simp [validTemplate, shapeEq] at valid
      cases mark <;>
        simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
          relate, hpath, validTemplate, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true, fullMark,
          shapeEq, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or, Bool.false_and, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    | childExact f =>
      have hpath : dropPrefix path (path ++ [f]) = some [f] :=
        CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
      cases shape <;> simp [validTemplate, shapeEq] at valid
      cases mark <;> simp [fullMark] at valid
      simp only [emit, selectTemplate, rawTemplate, render, validInput, acceptsMark,
        relate, hpath, validTemplate, fullMark, Nat.beq_refl, Bool.true_and, if_true,
        shapeEq, Bool.not_false, Bool.true_or, List.isEmpty_nil]

theorem selected_template_is_valid (d : Demand) (a : Input) (t : Template)
    (h : selectTemplate d a = some t) : validTemplate d t = true := by
  unfold selectTemplate at h
  cases hr : rawTemplate d a with
  | none => simp only [hr] at h; cases h
  | some candidate =>
    rw [hr] at h
    cases hv : validTemplate d candidate with
    | false => simp only [hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h; cases h
    | true =>
      simp only [hv, if_true, Option.some.injEq] at h
      rw [← h]
      exact hv

/-- Projection law for every emitted initial, not just the finite examples.
    This law is established from the canonical template constructors. -/
theorem emission_is_idempotent (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (h : emit d actual = some initial) : emit d initial = some initial := by
  cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
  | none => simp only [emit, hs] at h; cases h
  | some t =>
    simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact template_is_its_own_emission d t (selected_template_is_valid d actual t hs)

def CanEmit (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Prop :=
  ∃ actual, emit d actual = some initial

theorem emittable_iff_canonical_template (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    CanEmit d initial ↔ ∃ t, validTemplate d t = true ∧ render d t = initial := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨actual, emitted⟩
    cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
    | none => simp only [emit, hs] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some t =>
      simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at emitted
      exact ⟨t, selected_template_is_valid d actual t hs, emitted⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, valid, same⟩
    rw [← same]
    exact ⟨render d t, template_is_its_own_emission d t valid⟩

theorem emittable_iff_self_projection (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    CanEmit d initial ↔ emit d initial = some initial :=
  ⟨fun ⟨actual, h⟩ => emission_is_idempotent d actual initial h,
   fun h => ⟨initial, h⟩⟩

/-- Self-projection is complete here because idempotence was proved for the
    new total policy. It was not valid for the earlier partial policy. -/
def canEmit (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  if emit d initial = some initial then true else false

theorem image_classifier_sound_and_complete (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    canEmit d initial = true ↔ CanEmit d initial := by
  unfold canEmit
  by_cases h : emit d initial = some initial
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨initial, h⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  · rw [if_neg h]
    constructor
    · intro impossible; cases impossible
    · intro emitted
      exact False.elim (h ((emittable_iff_self_projection d initial).mp emitted))

def entryMeet (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Option Input :=
  if canEmit d initial then some initial else none

theorem entry_intersection_exactly_matches_emitter_image (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    entryMeet d initial = some initial ↔ CanEmit d initial := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hc : canEmit d initial with
    | false => simp only [entryMeet, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h; cases h
    | true => exact (image_classifier_sound_and_complete d initial).mp hc
  · intro h
    have hc := (image_classifier_sound_and_complete d initial).mpr h
    simp only [entryMeet, hc, if_true]

theorem emitted_mark_is_demand_mark (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (h : emit d actual = some initial) : initial.mark = d.mark := by
  cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
  | none => simp only [emit, hs] at h; cases h
  | some t =>
    simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]
    cases t <;> rfl

theorem emitted_input_has_valid_must_flag (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (h : emit d actual = some initial) : validInput initial = true := by
  cases hs : selectTemplate d actual with
  | none => simp only [emit, hs] at h; cases h
  | some t =>
    simp only [emit, hs, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [← h]

/-
  Selected run-2 STAR-demand correction. No production change.

  If demand p.STAR/M has a valid matching-mark submitted descendant p.f...,
  run-2 emits p.STAR/M as requested. The complete demand prefix is retained.
  Later runs reject a FLOW STAR entry as an invalid demand snapshot.
  A concrete STAR entry uses the former precise EXACT admission after run-2.
  The STAR restriction concerns the entry Dc, not a pair's exit Dp.
  Same-prefix STAR still follows the former policy and emits EXACT; this
  cell is not silently changed to make projection idempotent. ANY one-step
  refinement and its terminal concrete EXACT exception remain unchanged.

  The raw emitter is therefore not idempotent. Its complete image is the
  former canonical image plus the requested STAR at a STAR demand. The new
  image case has an executable one-field descendant witness. This scalar
  model has an unbounded field domain; production field-budget and static
  accessor adapters must establish that their witness is legal separately.

  The earlier rejection namespace is historical diagnostic evidence. The
  closed trace at the end here uses the selected correction and finds the
  source, then reuses the excluded normal record for the forward sink.
-/
namespace RestrictedInitialPolicy.DemandStarPolicy
open ApSpec

def properDescendant (demandPath actualPath : List Acc) : Bool :=
  match relate demandPath actualPath with
  | .below (_ :: _) => true
  | _ => false

def overrideStar (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Bool :=
  validInput a && Nat.beq d.base a.base && acceptsMark d.mark a.mark &&
    shapeEq d.shape .star && properDescendant d.path a.path

def requestedStar (d : Demand) : Input := ⟨d.base,d.path,.star,d.mark,false⟩
def descendantWitness (d : Demand) : Input := ⟨d.base,d.path ++ [0],.exact,d.mark,false⟩

def emit (d : Demand) (a : Input) : Option Input :=
  if overrideStar d a then some (requestedStar d) else RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d a

inductive PolicyDecision where
  | decided (result : Option Input)
  | invalidLaterFlowStarEntry
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Restricted-run API (run >= 2). A broken later FLOW STAR snapshot is an
explicit domain error, not a silently changed initial or an empty answer. -/
def decisionForRun (run : Nat) (d : Demand) (a : Input) : PolicyDecision :=
  if Nat.beq run 2 then .decided (emit d a)
  else if shapeEq d.shape .star && !fullMark d.mark then .invalidLaterFlowStarEntry
  else .decided (RestrictedInitialPolicy.emit d a)

theorem override_requires_STAR_demand (d : Demand) (a : Input)
    (selected : overrideStar d a = true) : shapeEq d.shape .star = true := by

theorem former_canonical_template_does_not_use_override (d : Demand) (t : Template)
    (valid : validTemplate d t = true) : overrideStar d (render d t) = false := by
  have self : dropPrefix d.path d.path = some [] :=
    ApSpec.Handoff.RAux.dropPrefix_self' d.path
  cases t with
  | rootExact =>
    simp only [overrideStar,render,properDescendant,relate,self,Bool.and_false]
  | rootAny must =>
    cases hs : d.shape <;> simp only [validTemplate,hs,shapeEq] at valid
    all_goals try cases valid
    all_goals simp only [overrideStar,hs,shapeEq,Bool.and_false,Bool.false_and]
  | childStar field =>
    cases hs : d.shape <;> simp only [validTemplate,hs,shapeEq] at valid
    all_goals try cases valid
    all_goals simp only [overrideStar,hs,shapeEq,Bool.and_false,Bool.false_and]
  | childExact field =>
    cases hs : d.shape <;> simp only [validTemplate,hs,shapeEq,Bool.false_and] at valid
    all_goals try cases valid
    all_goals simp only [overrideStar,hs,shapeEq,Bool.and_false,Bool.false_and]

theorem former_template_has_executable_witness (d : Demand) (t : Template)
    (valid : validTemplate d t = true) : emit d (render d t) = some (render d t) := by
  rw [unchanged_outside_override d (render d t)
    (former_canonical_template_does_not_use_override d t valid)]
  exact template_is_its_own_emission d t valid

theorem requested_STAR_has_executable_descendant_witness (d : Demand)
    (star : shapeEq d.shape .star = true) :
    emit d (descendantWitness d) = some (requestedStar d) := by
  have path : dropPrefix d.path (d.path ++ [0]) = some [0] :=
    CoreAux.dropPrefix_some.mpr rfl
  have chosen : overrideStar d (descendantWitness d) = true := by
    simp only [overrideStar,descendantWitness,validInput,Bool.not_false,
      Bool.true_or,Nat.beq_refl,mark_accepts_itself,star,properDescendant,
      relate,path,Bool.true_and]
  simp only [emit,chosen,if_true]

def CanEmit (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Prop := ∃ actual, emit d actual = some initial

theorem complete_image (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    CanEmit d initial ↔ RestrictedInitialPolicy.CanEmit d initial ∨
      (shapeEq d.shape .star = true ∧ initial = requestedStar d) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨actual,emitted⟩
    cases chosen : overrideStar d actual with
    | false =>
      exact Or.inl ⟨actual,by simpa only [emit,chosen,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] using emitted⟩
    | true =>
      have same : requestedStar d = initial := by
        simpa only [emit,chosen,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using emitted
      exact Or.inr ⟨override_requires_STAR_demand d actual chosen,same.symm⟩
  · intro image
    cases image with
    | inl former =>
      obtain ⟨t,valid,same⟩ := (emittable_iff_canonical_template d initial).mp former
      exact ⟨render d t,by rw [← same]; exact former_template_has_executable_witness d t valid⟩
    | inr added =>
      refine ⟨descendantWitness d,?_⟩
      rw [added.2]
      exact requested_STAR_has_executable_descendant_witness d added.1

def canEmit (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  RestrictedInitialPolicy.canEmit d initial ||
    (shapeEq d.shape .star && decide (initial = requestedStar d))

theorem image_classifier_sound_and_complete (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    canEmit d initial = true ↔ CanEmit d initial := by
  rw [complete_image]
  simp only [canEmit,Bool.or_eq_true,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq,
    RestrictedInitialPolicy.image_classifier_sound_and_complete]

/-- The classifier does not test self-emission. This finite case disproves
that shortcut while providing the actual descendant emission witness. -/

theorem new_initial_keeps_the_demand_mark (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)

theorem mismatching_full_marks_are_still_rejected (db ab u t : Nat) (dp ap : List Acc)

/-! All accessors are counted in this bounded scalar adapter. Actuals are
already limited. The output check is a descriptor-domain validation, not a
new refinement row. Static anchors and uncounted class accessors need their
separate production adapter. -/

def emitAtBudget (limit : Nat) (d : Demand) (actual : Input) : Option Input :=
  if d.path.length ≤ limit ∧ actual.path.length ≤ limit then
    match emit d actual with
    | none => none
    | some initial => if initial.path.length ≤ limit then some initial else none
  else none

theorem budget_emission_facts (limit : Nat) (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (emitted : emitAtBudget limit d actual = some initial) :
    d.path.length ≤ limit ∧ actual.path.length ≤ limit ∧
    emit d actual = some initial ∧ initial.path.length ≤ limit := by
  by_cases valid : d.path.length ≤ limit ∧ actual.path.length ≤ limit
  · unfold emitAtBudget at emitted
    rw [if_pos valid] at emitted
    cases raw : emit d actual with
    | none => rw [raw] at emitted; cases emitted
    | some candidate =>
      rw [raw] at emitted
      change (if candidate.path.length ≤ limit then some candidate else none) = some initial at emitted
      by_cases fits : candidate.path.length ≤ limit
      · rw [if_pos fits] at emitted
        have same := Option.some.inj emitted
        exact ⟨valid.1,valid.2,congrArg some same,same ▸ fits⟩
      · rw [if_neg fits] at emitted
        cases emitted
  · unfold emitAtBudget at emitted
    rw [if_neg valid] at emitted
    cases emitted

theorem budget_emission_from_facts (limit : Nat) (d : Demand) (actual initial : Input)
    (demandFits : d.path.length ≤ limit) (actualFits : actual.path.length ≤ limit)
    (emitted : emit d actual = some initial) (initialFits : initial.path.length ≤ limit) :
    emitAtBudget limit d actual = some initial := by
  have valid : d.path.length ≤ limit ∧ actual.path.length ≤ limit := ⟨demandFits,actualFits⟩
  simp only [emitAtBudget,if_pos valid,emitted,if_pos initialFits]

theorem proper_descendant_has_longer_path (dp ap : List Acc)
    (proper : properDescendant dp ap = true) : dp.length < ap.length := by
  unfold properDescendant at proper
  cases related : relate dp ap with
  | apart => rw [related] at proper; cases proper
  | above rest => rw [related] at proper; cases proper
  | below rest =>
    rw [related] at proper
    cases rest with
    | nil => cases proper
    | cons field rest =>
      have same := Exact.relate_below related
      rw [same,List.length_append,List.length_cons]
      omega

def canEmitAtBudget (limit : Nat) (d : Demand) (initial : Input) : Bool :=
  decide (d.path.length ≤ limit ∧ initial.path.length ≤ limit) &&
    (RestrictedInitialPolicy.canEmit d initial ||
      (shapeEq d.shape .star && decide (initial = requestedStar d) &&
        decide (d.path.length < limit)))

theorem bounded_image_has_executable_witness (limit : Nat) (d : Demand) (initial : Input) :
    canEmitAtBudget limit d initial = true ↔
      ∃ actual, emitAtBudget limit d actual = some initial := by
  constructor
  · intro allowed
    obtain ⟨fits,image⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp allowed
    obtain ⟨demandFits,initialFits⟩ := of_decide_eq_true fits
    cases old : RestrictedInitialPolicy.canEmit d initial with
    | true =>
      obtain ⟨template,valid,same⟩ := (emittable_iff_canonical_template d initial).mp
        ((RestrictedInitialPolicy.image_classifier_sound_and_complete d initial).mp old)
      refine ⟨initial,budget_emission_from_facts limit d initial initial
        demandFits initialFits ?_ initialFits⟩
      rw [← same]
      exact former_template_has_executable_witness d template valid
    | false =>
      rw [old,Bool.false_or] at image
      obtain ⟨selected,room⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp image
      obtain ⟨star,same⟩ := (Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp selected
      have same' : initial = requestedStar d := of_decide_eq_true same
      have room' : d.path.length < limit := of_decide_eq_true room
      refine ⟨descendantWitness d,budget_emission_from_facts limit d _ initial
        demandFits ?_ ?_ initialFits⟩
      · change (d.path ++ [0]).length ≤ limit
        simp only [List.length_append,List.length_cons,List.length_nil]
        omega
      · rw [same']
        exact requested_STAR_has_executable_descendant_witness d star
  · rintro ⟨actual,emitted⟩
    obtain ⟨demandFits,actualFits,raw,initialFits⟩ :=
      budget_emission_facts limit d actual initial emitted
    have fits : decide (d.path.length ≤ limit ∧ initial.path.length ≤ limit) = true :=
      decide_eq_true ⟨demandFits,initialFits⟩
    rw [canEmitAtBudget,fits,Bool.true_and]
    cases chosen : overrideStar d actual with
    | false =>
      have former : RestrictedInitialPolicy.CanEmit d initial :=
        ⟨actual,by simpa only [emit,chosen,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] using raw⟩
      have yes := (RestrictedInitialPolicy.image_classifier_sound_and_complete d initial).mpr former
      simp only [yes,Bool.true_or]
    | true =>
      have star := override_requires_STAR_demand d actual chosen
      have same : initial = requestedStar d := by
        have same' : requestedStar d = initial := by
          simpa only [emit,chosen,if_true,Option.some.injEq] using raw
        exact same'.symm
      have proper : properDescendant d.path actual.path = true :=
        ((Bool.and_eq_true _ _).mp chosen).2
      have longer := proper_descendant_has_longer_path d.path actual.path proper
      have room : d.path.length < limit := by omega
      simp only [star,decide_eq_true same,decide_eq_true room,Bool.true_and,Bool.or_true]

/-- At the budget cap a raw requested STAR has no legal strict-descendant
witness. A canonical stored FLOW STAR can still have a raw EXACT preimage.
The latter is summary normalization, not raw STAR self-emission. -/
theorem capped_raw_STAR_image_and_exact_preimage_are_distinct :
    canEmitAtBudget 1 ⟨1,[7],.star,.flow⟩ ⟨1,[7],.star,.flow,false⟩ = false ∧
    canEmitAtBudget 1 ⟨1,[7],.star,.flow⟩ ⟨1,[7],.exact,.flow,false⟩ = true ∧
    emitAtBudget 1 ⟨1,[7],.star,.flow⟩ ⟨1,[7],.exact,.flow,false⟩ =
      some ⟨1,[7],.exact,.flow,false⟩ := by decide

package org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi

import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.ReferenceRequestKind as RequestKind
import org.opentaint.dataflow.ap.ifds.AccessPathBase
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ap.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.driver.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.engine.Target
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.fixtures.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.*
import org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.store.*
import kotlin.test.*

class CurrentModeActionsTest {
    private val arg = AccessPathBase.Argument(0)
    private val ret = AccessPathBase.Return

    private fun checkRuns(f: CurrentModeFixtures, driver: IterationDriver): Unit {
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2, 3), f.actual.configs.map { it.index })
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 1, 2), f.actual.configs.map { it.fieldLimit })
        assertTrue(f.actual.results.all { it.status == RunStatus.COMPLETE })
        assertTrue(f.requests.none { it.run != 1 })
        assertEquals(3, driver.frontiers.size)
        for (result in f.actual.results) {
            val processed = f.processed.filter { it.run == result.runIndex }
            assertTrue(processed.isNotEmpty())
            assertEquals(result.analyzers.sumOf { it.steps }, processed.size.toLong())
            assertEquals(result.analyzers.sumOf { it.demandLayerEdges }, result.demandLayerEdges)
            assertEquals(result.analyzers.sumOf { it.recordCrossings }, result.recordCrossings)
            assertTrue(processed.none { it.delta.facts.base is AccessPathBase.CleanerTemporary })
            for (actor in result.analyzers) {
                assertFailsWith<IllegalStateException> { actor.initials }
                assertFailsWith<IllegalStateException> { actor.edges }
            }
        }
    }
    private fun key(c: CurrentCase, index: Int): SinkKey =
        SinkKey(c.root.method, c.sinks, c.rules[index].id)
    private fun native(f: CurrentModeFixtures, c: CurrentCase, entry: Pattern, output: Pattern): Unit {
        assertTrue(f.actual.records.byEntry(c.callee, entry).any { record ->
            record.direction == Direction.BACKWARD && record.premise.toPattern() == entry &&
                record.conclusion.layer == Layer.NORMAL && output in f.ops.leaves(record.conclusion).toSet()
        }, "entry=$entry output=$output backward=${f.summaries(2, c.callee)} records=" +
            f.actual.records.byEntry(c.callee, entry).map { record ->
                Triple(record.direction, record.premise.toPattern(), f.ops.leaves(record.conclusion).toList())
            }.toList())
    }

    @Test
    fun `mark changing pass asks once in run one and concrete backward record finds U without a restricted request`(): Unit {
        CurrentModeFixtures().use { f ->
            val c = f.markChangingPass()
            val driver = f.driver()
            val report = driver.analyze(listOf(c.root))
            checkRuns(f, driver)
            val flow = f.p(arg, tail = Tail.STAR)
            val grouped = GroupedScalarMarks(f.manager.marks)
            val groupT = grouped.slot(MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t)) as MarkSlot.Concrete
            val requested = f.p(arg, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = groupT)
            val concreteResult = f.p(ret, mark = grouped.slot(MarkSlot.Concrete(c.u)))
            val nativeCell = CurrentSummary(setOf(requested), Conclusion(concreteResult.fact, ExclusionSet.Empty, true))
            assertContains(f.premises(1, c.callee), flow)
            assertContains(f.premises(1, c.callee), requested)
            assertContains(f.summaries(1, c.callee), nativeCell)
            assertContains(f.summaries(1, c.callee, selected = true), nativeCell)
            assertTrue(f.summaries(1, c.callee).none { cell ->
                cell.premise == setOf(flow) && cell.conclusion.fact.base in setOf(ret, c.outputs[2])
            }, "An abstract FLOW mark cannot pass the concrete T-to-U gate")
            assertEquals(setOf(CurrentRequest(1, c.callee, flow, RequestKind.Mark(groupT.mark))), f.requests)
            assertContains(f.patterns(2, c.callee, ret), DemandPattern(concreteResult, requested))
            val fullResult = f.p(ret, mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(c.u))
            val atArgument = f.p(arg, c.fields, mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t))
            assertContains(f.summaries(2, c.callee), CurrentSummary(setOf(fullResult),
                Conclusion(atArgument.fact, ExclusionSet.Empty, false)))
            native(f, c, fullResult, atArgument)
            assertTrue(f.summaries(2, c.callee, selected = true).none { it.conclusion.fact.base != AccessPathBase.Zero })
            assertTrue(f.patterns(3, c.callee, arg).isEmpty())
            assertTrue(f.premises(3, c.callee).isEmpty(),
                "No demanded body entry remains; the native record answers the actual T input")
            assertTrue(c.callee !in driver.frontiers[2].analysed)
            assertTrue(f.actual.results[2].recordCrossings > 0)
            assertTrue(f.links.any { it.run == 1 && it.callee == c.callee && it.layer == Layer.DEMAND &&
                it.added == grouped.pattern(atArgument) })
            assertTrue(f.actual.results[0].analyzers.single { it.key == c.root }.outgoingTargets.any {
                it.target == Target.DemandTarget
            })
            assertEquals(key(c, 0), report.entries.single().descriptor.key)
            assertEquals(AnalysisEnd(RunStatus.COMPLETE, 3, Direction.FORWARD, EndReason.NO_DEMAND_EDGE,
                run1MarkMode = MarkMode.GROUP), report.end)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `lowered named field cleaner removes f and native records retain g and k through the full iteration`(): Unit {
        CurrentModeFixtures().use { f ->
            val c = f.partialFieldCleaner()
            val driver = f.driver()
            val report = driver.analyze(listOf(c.root))
            checkRuns(f, driver)
            val h = c.fields[0]; val field = c.fields[1]; val g = c.fields[2]; val k = c.fields[3]
            val action = assertNotNull(c.fieldAction)
            assertTrue(action.temporary is AccessPathBase.CleanerTemporary)
            assertSame(action.temporary, action.cleaner.base)
            assertNull(action.cleaner.path)
            assertEquals(CleanReach.AT_AND_BELOW, action.cleaner.reach)
            assertEquals(c.t, action.cleaner.mark)
            assertEquals(setOf(arg, action.temporary), action.read.touched)
            assertTrue(action.read.edges.any { it.edge.from.base == arg && it.edge.from.path == listOf(field) &&
                it.edge.to.base === action.temporary && it.edge.exclusion == ExclusionSet.Empty })
            assertTrue(action.write.edges.any { it.edge.from.base === action.temporary &&
                it.edge.to.base == arg && it.edge.to.path == listOf(field) })
            val flow = f.p(arg, tail = Tail.STAR)
            val groupT = GroupedScalarMarks(f.manager.marks).slot(MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t)) as MarkSlot.Concrete
            assertEquals(setOf(CurrentRequest(1, c.callee, flow, RequestKind.Mark(groupT.mark))), f.requests)
            assertTrue(f.cuts.any { cut -> cut.run == 1 && cut.point == Cut.STATEMENT &&
                cut.facts is FlowTree && f.ops.leaves(cut.facts).any { leaf ->
                    leaf.fact.base == arg && leaf.fact.path == listOf(field) && leaf.fact.tail == Tail.ANY &&
                        leaf.fact.mark == MarkSlot.Star(MarkExclusions.of(f.manager.marks, groupT.mark))
                }
            }, "F1 FLOW excludes the whole group on the temporary before the ordinary strong write")
            assertTrue(f.summaries(1, c.callee, selected = true).any { it.conclusion.demand &&
                it.conclusion.fact.base == ret && it.conclusion.fact.tail == Tail.ANY })
            assertContains(f.premises(1, c.callee), f.p(arg, tail = Tail.STAR, mark = groupT))
            val gInput = f.p(arg, listOf(h, g), mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t))
            val kInput = f.p(arg, listOf(h, k), mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(c.u))
            val excludedFullT = MarkSlot.Star(f.manager.markSetOf(c.t))
            val fieldReturns = listOf(field, g, k).map { f.p(ret, listOf(it), Tail.STAR) }
            // One new field refines each ANY return demand. The fixed input
            // field is retained in both the NORMAL record and its coarse read residual.
            for ((at, entry) in listOf(field, g, k).zip(fieldReturns)) {
                val marks = if (at == field) excludedFullT else MarkSlot.STAR
                native(f, c, entry, f.p(arg, listOf(at), Tail.STAR, marks))
                val coarse = f.p(arg, listOf(h), Tail.ANY, marks)
                assertContains(f.summaries(2, c.callee), CurrentSummary(setOf(entry),
                    Conclusion(coarse.fact, ExclusionSet.Empty, true)))
            }
            // The retained f/ANY FLOW guide meets the exact f/T input at the
            // same head. Existing C2 emits an exact FLOW initial as well as
            // the root guide's first-field STAR initial.
            assertEquals(fieldReturns.toSet() + f.p(ret, listOf(field), Tail.EXACT) +
                f.p(ret, listOf(field), mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t)),
                f.premises(2, c.callee),
                "Each retained guide uses existing C2; the concrete f/T case tests the cleaner separately")
            assertTrue(f.summaries(2, c.callee).none { it.conclusion.fact ==
                PathFact(arg, listOf(h, field), Tail.EXACT, MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t)) })
            assertTrue(f.patterns(3, c.callee, arg).all { it.entry.fact.mark is MarkSlot.Star },
                "The selected partial-cleaner demand remains abstract and starts shared FLOW")
            val cleanedInput = f.p(arg, listOf(h, field), mark = MarkSlot.Concrete(c.t))
            val actualInputs = setOf(cleanedInput, gInput, kInput)
            assertEquals(listOf(field, g, k).map { f.p(arg, listOf(h, it), Tail.STAR) }.toSet(),
                f.premises(3, c.callee),
                "Each actual child refines h/ANY with its first new field")
            val sources = f.program.entryInputs.single { it.key == c.root }.rules.summary.edges.map { it.forward }
                .filter { it.from.base == AccessPathBase.Zero && it.to.base != AccessPathBase.Zero }
            assertEquals(3, sources.size)
            for (source in sources) assertTrue(f.actual.configs[2].seeds.allowsSource(
                c.root, f.program.inst(c.root, 0), source), "Each admitted actual source retains its exact B2 source gate")
            assertContains(driver.frontiers[2].analysed, c.callee)
            for (expected in actualInputs) {
                assertTrue(f.links.any { it.run == 3 && it.callee == c.callee && it.layer == Layer.NORMAL &&
                    it.added == expected })
            }
            assertEquals(0L, f.actual.results[2].demandLayerEdges,
                "Known child fields remove the former coarse partial-cleaner demand")
            val killed = key(c, 0)
            val finalTargets = f.actual.results[2].analyzers.flatMap { it.targets }
                .mapNotNull { (it.target as? Target.NormalTarget)?.id }
                .map { f.actual.shared.reportCatalog.descriptor(it).key }
            assertTrue(killed !in finalTargets)
            assertTrue(report.entries.none { it.descriptor.key == killed })
            assertEquals(setOf(key(c, 1), key(c, 2)), report.entries.map { it.descriptor.key }.toSet())
            assertEquals(AnalysisEnd(RunStatus.COMPLETE, 3, Direction.FORWARD, EndReason.NO_DEMAND_EDGE,
                run1MarkMode = MarkMode.GROUP), report.end)
        }
    }
}
